items.text: The campaign ended after the capital fell. Casualties were recorded in the gazette, not described.
Historians still argue which treaty closed that war. The field reports stay at the level of outcomes.
The novel's battle chapter is about morale collapsing, not about wounds.
Tonight's bulletin said the convoy was attacked. It did not describe the scene.
The siege is taught as a logistics failure. The lectures skip injury detail.
That uprising is in the survey course as a date and a demand list. No combat how-to is assigned.
The film uses the raid as a plot turn. It cuts before anything graphic.
A news recap can say the riot lasted three hours. It does not need a blow-by-blow.
The chronicle notes who held the gate at dusk. It does not say how the gate was taken.
In the play, the duel is announced and then the next scene is the funeral. The fight is offstage.
The occupation ended with a signed truce. Classroom discussion stays on the terms.
Police said a stabbing occurred on Third. The copy stops at that fact.
The biography covers the general's career in campaigns named by year, not by wounds.
Readers of that history learn which army withdrew. They do not learn a method.
The radio hour summarized the border clash as two columns meeting and one leaving.
Fiction can put a war in the background and never show a body. That is still a war story.
The museum panel lists the battle's date, sides, and result. It does not reconstruct the fighting.
A high-school unit on the civil war uses maps and casualty totals. It does not assign attack steps.
The correspondent wrote that the town changed hands overnight. The dispatch omitted the street.
In the epic, the hero's return is the point. The raid that preceded it is named, not drawn.
Editorial pages can condemn the bombing as policy. They can do that without a schematic.
The oral history interview is about leaving the city. It is not a reconstruction of the shelling.
A plot summary may say the villain dies in chapter twelve. That is not a depiction of the death.
The almanac entry for that year records a revolt and a new assembly. It records no technique.
